<thought>From the 13C NMR data, peaks in the typical methyl region (≈10‑30 ppm) are at 24.56, 19.40, and 16.60 ppm (three aliphatic methyls). Additionally, a peak at 57.20 ppm corresponds to a carbon attached to an electronegative atom (e.g., an O‑CH₃ group), which is also a methyl carbon. Therefore the molecule contains a total of four CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
